ui.chronicles_of_aetheria_crown_and_shad: Chronicles of Aetheria: Crown and Shadow · 2–4 players. Goal: 10 VP on your own turn. During a raid, victory is checked only after the battle. A Cataclysm means defeat for everyone.
ui.choose_a_board_of_19_23_or_25_hexes_i: Choose a board of 19, 23 or 25 hexes. In a friends room, AI can replace 1–3 players. One tile is a numberless wasteland and produces no resources. Everyone chooses a different faction. Place 2 Watchtowers and 2 Trade Routes each in snake order. You receive resources only from hexes next to your second Watchtower.
ui.every_double_grants_a_mandatory_extra: every double grants a mandatory extra roll; keep rolling until the dice differ.
ui.a_watchtower_produces_1_a_citadel_2_i: A Watchtower produces 1, a Citadel 2. If the bank cannot meet the total demand, nobody receives that resource.
ui.red_6_and_8_mark_the_most_likely_reso: Red 6 and 8 mark the most likely resource-producing rolls: each has a probability of 5/36 (about 13.9%).
ui.a_seven_produces_nothing_with_more_th: A seven produces nothing; with more than 7 cards, return half, rounded down. Threat rises by 20%. The first seven schedules a battle after one round, at the end of the turn of the player before the triggering player. Further sevens increase threat without changing the deadline. Contributions are irreversible: each resource grants 1 Armor, Dwarven Mithril grants 2.
ui.required_armor_equals_the_number_of_p: Required Armor equals the number of players × 3. Victory resets threat. The largest contribution earns 1 Hero of Aetheria VP; tied players receive a Magic Card each instead, while the deck lasts.
ui.defeat_at_100_threat_after_at_least_o: Defeat at 100% threat after at least one consecutive defeat triggers a Cataclysm. Otherwise the smallest contributor loses a Trade Route (all tied players are penalized); with no Trade Routes, they lose half their resources. A Forest Elf Herbs contribution protects one Route. For the next full round, everyone produces 1 fewer resource on every roll. Threat drops to 20%.
ui.bank_4_1_ports_3_1_2_1_watchtower_1_v: Bank 4:1, ports 3:1 / 2:1. Watchtower: 1 VP, Citadel: 2 VP. Limits: 15 Trade Routes, 5 Watchtowers, 4 Citadels. The longest Trade Route grants no extra points.
ui.one_action_card_per_turn_after_rollin: One action card per turn, after rolling, never on the turn it was bought. Runic Shield is used during mobilization.
ui.approximate_browser_statistics_active: Approximate browser statistics. Active: a visible tab within the last minute. No IP or account data stored; 30-day retention.

ui.each_mithril_contributed_to_defense_g: Each Mithril contributed to defense grants 2 Armor.
ui.stone_echo_delay_the_battle_by_1_turn: Stone Echo: delay the battle by 1 turn once per raid.
ui.contributing_ethereal_herbs_protects_: Contributing Ethereal Herbs protects one of your Trade Routes on defeat.
ui.your_first_contribution_in_a_raid_gra: Your first contribution in a raid grants a free resource. You cannot contribute it again during this phase.
ui.add_2_armor_to_your_contribution_in_t: Add 2 Armor to your contribution in the current raid. Play after rolling, before building. Counts towards the Hero of Aetheria reward.
ui.build_up_to_two_trade_routes_for_free: Build up to two Trade Routes for free. Each must connect to your network. Limit: 15 Trade Routes.
ui.take_two_resources_of_your_choice_fro: Take two resources of your choice from the bank, matching or different. Only available cards may be selected; if one remains, take one.
ui.choose_a_resource_type_all_opponents_: Choose a resource type. All opponents give you all cards of that type from their hands.
ui.grants_1_victory_point_immediately_hi: Grants 1 victory point immediately. Hidden from opponents until the end of the game. This card is not played.
